title: Spine: Compiling Subtask Trees into Structured Context for Long-Horizon Coding Agents
title_zh: Spine：将子任务树编译为结构化上下文以支持长程编码智能体

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon coding tasks contain nested subtasks. Typically, agents record interactions sequentially into a growing history as model context, causing severe context inflation and performance degradation. One group of existing context-management approaches compresses or trims the history without explicit subtask boundaries, such that context reduction can discard information needed by unfinished subtasks, leading to repeated exploration and disrupted task progress. On the other hand, recursive subagent delegation isolates completed subtasks through child agents via assigning every subtask boundary to delegation, which conflates subtask granularity with executing agent choice, adding execution and coordination overhead. This raises a question: how can model context align with subtask nesting and completion without incurring the high overhead of additional agents? To answer this question, we introduce Spine , an interface and runtime that align model context with subtask nesting and completion in a just-in-time manner. Specifically, an agent declares explicit subtask boundaries through work scopes, allowing the same agent to execute nested subtasks inline without multi-agent overhead, while reserving delegation for independent parallel tasks. The runtime organizes execution in SpineTree, a persistent tree that serves as the structural spine recording subtask relations, local interactions, completion states, and returned results. Before each model call, the runtime compiles the tree into model context just in time , retaining unfinished subtasks’ interactions and replacing completed subtasks’ details with their submitted results, while preserving prefix-cache reuse.
paragraphs.zh: 长周期编码任务包含嵌套的子任务。 通常，智能体会把交互按顺序记录到不断增长的历史中作为模型上下文，导致严重的上下文膨胀和性能下降。 现有的一类上下文管理方法在没有明确子任务边界的情况下压缩或裁剪历史，因此上下文缩减可能会丢弃未完成子任务所需的信息，导致重复探索并扰乱任务进度。 另一方面，递归式子智能体委派通过把每个子任务边界都交给委派来利用子智能体隔离已完成的子任务，这将子任务粒度与执行智能体的选择混为一谈，增加了执行与协调开销。 这引出一个问题：如何让模型上下文与子任务的嵌套和完成对齐，又不产生额外智能体的高昂开销？ 为回答这个问题，我们提出 Spine，这是一个以即时方式让模型上下文与子任务嵌套和完成对齐的接口与运行时。 具体而言，智能体通过工作范围声明显式的子任务边界，使同一个智能体能够内联执行嵌套子任务而无需多智能体开销，同时将委派保留给相互独立的并行任务。 该运行时将执行组织为 SpineTree，这是一棵持久化树，作为记录子任务关系、本地交互、完成状态和返回结果的结构性主干。 在每次模型调用之前，运行时会即时将该树编译为模型上下文，保留未完成子任务的交互，并用已完成子任务提交的结果替换其细节，同时保持前缀缓存的复用。

paragraphs.en: We integrate Spine into Codex, OpenAI’s popular coding-agent harness, to build SpineCodex . We evaluate it on three widely-adopted long-horizon benchmarks: SWE-Milestone for repository evolution, ProgramBench for whole-program reconstruction, and FrontierSWE for open-ended engineering. With GPT-5.6 Sol, SpineCodex improves SWE-Milestone Score by 11.8% while reducing total cost by 32.4%, compared with native Codex. It also achieves a comparable Score to Recursive Subagent at 73.7% lower total cost. With the same model, it improves the average ProgramBench test-pass rate by 17.3% compared with native Codex and improves Mean@5, i.e., the mean score over five trials per task, on eight of the ten evaluated FrontierSWE tasks. To evaluate generalizability, we integrate Spine into Pi, a popular open-source coding-agent harness with an extensible architecture, through a reusable software package. With Gemini 3.8 Flash and the open-weight Qwen 3.8 27B, this integration improves SWE-Milestone Score by 9.5–17.5% and the average ProgramBench test-pass rate by 4.3–8.7%, compared with native Pi.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 Spine 集成到 Codex（OpenAI 流行的编码智能体框架）中，构建了 SpineCodex。 我们在三个广泛采用的长时程基准上进行评估：用于仓库演化的 SWE-Milestone、用于整个程序重构的 ProgramBench，以及用于开放式工程的 FrontierSWE。 与原生 Codex 相比，使用 GPT-5.6 Sol 时，SpineCodex 将 SWE-Milestone 分数提升了 11.8%，同时将总成本降低了 32.4%。 它还以低于 Recursive Subagent 73.7% 的总成本取得了与其相当的分数。 使用相同的模型，相比原生 Codex，它将 ProgramBench 的平均测试通过率提升了 17.3%，并在十个受评估的 FrontierSWE 任务中的八个上提升了 Mean@5（即每个任务五次试验的平均分数）。 为了评估泛化能力，我们通过一个可复用的软件包将 Spine 集成到 Pi——一个具有可扩展架构的流行开源编码智能体框架中。 使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和开源权重的 Qwen 3.8 27B，与原生 Pi 相比，该集成将 SWE-Milestone 分数提升了 9.5–17.5%，将 ProgramBench 的平均测试通过率提升了 4.3–8.7%。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents are increasingly used for complex, long-horizon software-engineering tasks ( Anthropic, 0000 ; Johnston et al., 2026 ) . For example, in May 2026, roughly one in four sampled active individual users of Codex, OpenAI’s coding agent, had submitted a request estimated to require at least eight hours of human work ( Johnston et al., 2026 ) . These tasks contain nested subtasks, i.e., subtasks themselves containing further subtasks. When a subtask completes, the agent uses its result to resume its parent task, i.e., the task that directly contains it. To complete such tasks, a coding agent iteratively reasons, invokes tools, and uses the resulting observations to guide subsequent interactions ( Yao et al., 2023 ) . The agent harness, i.e., the software that runs tools and prepares model inputs, encapsulates these interactions into subsequent model calls as a growing interaction history ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , which forms part of the model context as the input information supplied to each model call. However, simply recording interactions in turn as history is impractical, since it could easily inflate the context and reduce agent effectiveness, making it essential to select which interactions to encapsulate. Intuitively, for completed subtasks, only their returned results are likely needed by their parent task rather than detailed original interactions, which are in fact essential for proceeding with unfinished subtasks ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 编程智能体正日益被用于复杂、长周期的软件工程任务（Anthropic, 0000；Johnston et al., 2026）。 例如，2026 年 5 月，在抽样的 Codex（OpenAI 的编程智能体）活跃个人用户中，约有四分之一的用户提交过一项预计至少需要八小时人工工作的请求（Johnston et al., 2026）。 这些任务包含嵌套的子任务，即子任务本身又包含更深层的子任务。 当一个子任务完成时，智能体会利用其结果来恢复其父任务，即直接包含该子任务的任务。 为了完成此类任务，编程智能体会迭代地进行推理、调用工具，并利用得到的观察结果来指导后续的交互（Yao et al., 2023）。 智能体框架（agent harness），即运行工具并准备模型输入的软件，将这些交互封装进后续的模型调用中，形成一个不断增长的交互历史（Wang et al., 2025），该历史构成模型上下文的一部分，即提供给每次模型调用的输入信息。 然而，仅仅按顺序将交互记录为历史是不可行的，因为这很容易导致上下文膨胀并降低智能体的有效性，因此必须选择哪些交互需要被封装。 直观地说，对于已完成的子任务，其父任务很可能只需要其返回的结果，而不是详细的原始交互；而对于未完成的子任务，这些详细的原始交互实际上是继续推进所必需的（Xiao et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches manage context by compressing or trimming the interaction history, or by assigning subtasks to child agents. History compression and trimming reduce the information encapsulated into later calls. For instance, AgentDiet removes redundant or expired content ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , while AgentFold lets the agent summarize selected parts of the history at different granular levels ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . Context Folding uses a plan–branch–return workflow trained with FoldGRPO , in which the returned result of a completed branch replaces its intermediate interactions ( Sun et al., 2025 ) . However, reducing interaction history does not by itself maintain subtask relations, completion status, or where unfinished work should resume. When this information must be recovered from reduced context, the model may lose track of progress, repeat exploration ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , or declare completion while work remains unfinished ( Young, 2025 ) . These failures add execution cost and disrupt continued progress.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通过压缩或裁剪交互历史，或将子任务分配给子智能体来管理上下文。 历史压缩和裁剪会减少封装进后续调用中的信息。 例如，AgentDiet 会移除冗余或过期的内容（Xiao et al., 2026），而 AgentFold 则让智能体以不同的粒度级别对历史中被选中的部分进行摘要（Ye et al., 2026）。 Context Folding 使用通过 FoldGRPO 训练的「计划—分支—返回」工作流，其中已完成分支的返回结果会替换其间的中间交互（Sun et al., 2025）。 然而，缩减交互历史本身并不能维持子任务之间的关系、完成状态，或未完成工作应从何处恢复。 当这些信息必须从缩减后的上下文中恢复时，模型可能会丢失进度、重复探索（Deng et al., 2026），或在工作尚未完成时就宣告完成（Young, 2025）。 这些失败会增加执行成本并阻碍持续进展。

paragraphs.en: Recursive subagent delegation instead assigns subtasks to child agents with separate contexts, which can in turn delegate further subtasks and return their results. For example, Recursive Agent Harnesses gives each child a complete tool-using harness with its own workspace and context ( Lumer et al., 2026b ) . These calls represent subtask nesting and isolate completed work through returned results, but using them to establish every subtask boundary forces delegation and adds execution and coordination overhead, even when the current agent could perform the work itself. Studies of multi-agent systems show that communication inflation and redundant messages can directly degrade task performance ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) , while divergent context prefixes force shared information to be repeatedly reprocessed without KV-cache reuse ( Ye et al., 2025 ) . Crucially, whether a subtask is delegated to another agent or executed locally by the current agent, the agent still makes decisions about when the subtask starts, completes, and returns. However, existing interaction histories lack an explicit representation of these boundaries and completion states.

sents.zh: 对多智能体系统的研究表明，通信膨胀和冗余消息会直接降低任务性能（Zhang et al., 2025；Zhu et al., 2025），而上下文前缀的分歧则迫使共享信息被反复重新处理，无法复用 KV 缓存（Ye et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Crucially, whether a subtask is delegated to another agent or executed locally by the current agent, the agent still makes decisions about when the subtask starts, completes, and returns.
sents.zh: 至关重要的是，无论子任务是被委托给另一个智能体，还是由当前智能体本地执行，智能体仍需对子任务何时开始、完成和返回做出决策。

sents.en: However, existing interaction histories lack an explicit representation of these boundaries and completion states.
sents.zh: 然而，现有的交互历史缺乏对这些边界和完成状态的显式表示。

paragraphs.en: To summarize, these observations lead to three issues in context management: (1) the lack of an explicit representation of subtask boundaries and completion status in the interaction history; (2) the lack of separation between subtask granularity and executing agent choice; and (3) the lack of a history representation distinguishing between completed and unfinished subtasks for parent tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，这些观察引出了上下文管理中的三个问题：（1）交互历史中缺乏对子任务边界和完成状态的显式表示；（2）子任务粒度与执行智能体选择之间缺乏分离；（3）缺乏一种能够区分父任务中已完成与未完成子任务的历史表示。

paragraphs.en: This raises a question: how can model context align with subtask nesting and completion without incurring the high overhead of additional agents? Ideally, the same agent should be able to complete a subtask and resume its parent task with the result, while retaining information needed by other unfinished subtasks with explicit subtask boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 这就引出了一个疑问：如何让模型上下文与子任务的嵌套和完成保持一致，又不产生额外智能体所带来的高额开销？ 理想情况下，同一个智能体应能够完成一个子任务并携带结果恢复其父任务，同时在子任务边界明确的情况下保留其他未完成子任务所需的信息。

sents.en: This raises a question: how can model context align with subtask nesting and completion without incurring the high overhead of additional agents?

sents.en: Ideally, the same agent should be able to complete a subtask and resume its parent task with the result, while retaining information needed by other unfinished subtasks with explicit subtask boundaries.
sents.zh: 理想情况下，同一个智能体应能够完成一个子任务并携带结果恢复其父任务，同时在子任务边界明确的情况下保留其他未完成子任务所需的信息。

paragraphs.en: To answer this question, we introduce Spine , an interface and runtime that align model context with subtask nesting and completion while supporting both local execution and delegation in a just-in-time manner. Specifically, Spine addresses the aforementioned issues through three key designs. (1) To provide an explicit representation of subtask boundaries and completion status, the agent declares a work scope, i.e., a subtask with an explicit entry, a parent task, and a result submitted on completion. (2) To separate subtask granularity from executing agent choice, a work scope can span multiple model calls and tool interactions, where the current agent can open nested scopes within it, complete each scope by submitting a result, and resume the parent task locally, while independent subtasks can be delegated to other agents for parallel execution so that subtask boundaries do not determine which agent executes the work. (3) To distinguish completed subtasks and unfinished subtasks for parent tasks, the runtime maintains a persistent execution tree, namely SpineTree, and compiles it into model context just in time before each model call, retaining unfinished work scopes’ interactions and replacing completed scopes’ details with their submitted results. More specifically, SpineTree serves as the structural spine recording the current agent’s scopes, their nesting, interactions, and completion status, together with submitted results and results returned by delegated agents. Completing a work scope therefore both resumes its parent with the submitted result and changes the context supplied to the next call. Notably, the detailed interactions remain preserved in SpineTree, while the unchanged context preceding the scope remains eligible for prefix-cache reuse.
paragraphs.zh: 为了回答这个问题，我们提出了 Spine，一种将模型上下文与子任务嵌套和完成状态对齐的接口与运行时，同时以即时方式支持本地执行和委托。 具体而言，Spine 通过三个关键设计解决了上述问题。 (1) 为了显式表示子任务边界和完成状态，智能体会声明一个工作范围，即一个具有显式入口、父任务以及完成时提交结果的子任务。 (2) 为了将子任务粒度与执行智能体的选择解耦，一个工作范围可以跨越多次模型调用和工具交互，其中当前智能体可以在其中打开嵌套范围，通过提交结果来完成每个范围，并在本地恢复父任务，而独立的子任务可以委托给其他智能体并行执行，从而使子任务边界不决定由哪个智能体执行该工作。 (3) 为了让父任务能够区分已完成子任务和未完成子任务，运行时维护一个持久的执行树，即 SpineTree，并在每次模型调用之前即时将其编译为模型上下文，保留未完成工作范围的交互内容，并将已完成范围的细节替换为其提交的结果。 更具体地说，SpineTree 作为记录当前智能体的范围、它们的嵌套关系、交互内容和完成状态的结构性主干，同时记录已提交的结果以及受委托智能体返回的结果。 因此，完成一个工作范围既会用提交的结果恢复其父任务，也会改变提供给下一次调用的上下文。 值得注意的是，详细的交互内容仍保留在 SpineTree 中，而该范围之前未发生变化的上下文仍然可以用于前缀缓存复用。

paragraphs.en: We integrate Spine into the agent harness of Codex, OpenAI’s widely used coding product ( OpenAI, 2026b ; OpenAI, 2026a ) , to build SpineCodex . We evaluate effectiveness and cost using GPT-5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026d ) and Grok 4.6 ( xAI, 2026 ) on three widely-adopted long-horizon coding benchmarks: SWE-Milestone ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , ProgramBench ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , and FrontierSWE ( Chu et al., 2026 ) . On SWE-Milestone with GPT-5.6 Sol, SpineCodex improves Score by 11.8%, 16.7%, and 14.8% while reducing total cost by 32.4%, 58.1%, and 22.7%, compared with native Codex, AgentDiet , and Context Folding , respectively. It also achieves a comparable Score to Recursive Subagent at 73.7% lower total cost. With the same model, it improves the average ProgramBench test-pass rate by 17.3% compared with native Codex, and FrontierSWE’s Mean@5, i.e., the mean score over five trials per task, on eight of ten evaluated tasks. To evaluate generalizability, we integrate Spine as a plugin into Pi ( earendil-works, 2026a ) , a popular open-source coding-agent harness with an extensible architecture ( Earendil, 2026 ) , through its official extension interface ( earendil-works, 2026b ) . Using Gemini 3.8 Flash ( Google, 2026 ) and the open-weight Qwen 3.8 27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , this integration improves SWE-Milestone Score by 9.5–17.5% and the average ProgramBench test-pass rate by 4.3–8.7%, compared with native Pi.

paragraphs.en: We first consider an agent that compresses a flat interaction history without explicitly representing the nested structure of its subtasks ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . The reduced context must still allow the model to identify which inspections have already been completed and where implementation should resume. In Figure 2 (a), the agent inspects nine source files, and the resulting inspection history is replaced by a summary. The next response rereads overlapping ranges from seven of these files, and a later response revisits seven again. In this trace, the agent revisits previously inspected source while implementation remains unfinished. paragraphs.en: Next, we consider an agent that delegates subtasks to child agents, which can in turn delegate further subtasks. Each child has a local context and returns a result to its parent, giving nested work separate execution boundaries. The parent must assign work, communicate requirements, check progress, and collect results. If subsequent work depends on a child’s result, the parent must wait for it before proceeding. In the milestone shown in Figure 2 (b), the parent issues twelve wait calls and makes fourteen attempts to create child agents, three of which are blocked by the thread limit. These handoffs and coordination steps add model and tool interactions alongside the child agents’ own execution. Thus, relying on delegation merely to isolate context introduces substantial coordination overhead, particularly when the parent simply blocks to await sequential results.

paragraphs.en: Ideally, an agent could complete the nested compilation check and resume the parser update with its earlier context and the check result within its own execution, as in Figure 3 . The agent would first mark the check’s beginning, allowing the runtime to record its interactions separately from the ongoing parser work. When the check completes, the agent would return a result such as “targeted crates compile”. The runtime would replace the check’s intermediate reads, repairs, and compiler output with this result in the next model input, while retaining the context of the unfinished parser update. With the check result available, the same agent could continue the parser update for local-variable completion. When the parser update finishes, its result would return to the migration in the same way, while other changes and workspace validation remain pending. This example motivates explicit subtask boundaries that let the current agent replace completed subtasks’ details with their results while retaining information needed by unfinished parent tasks and leaving the choice of executing agents independent of the boundary.

paragraphs.en: Coding-agent harnesses, e.g., Codex, Claude Code, and Pi, let an agent inspect, modify, and test a repository through repeated model calls and tool use ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026b ; Anthropic, 2026a ; earendil-works, 2026a ; Anomalyco, 2026 ; DeepSeek AI, 2026 ; Cursor Team, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026b ) . As shown in Figure 4 , the harness repeatedly executes tool calls, records their results, and prepares the next model input. As the loop repeats, the harness accumulates interactions and selects what context to include in each subsequent model call. Typically, the interaction history refers to the record of these interactions and model context refers to the input to one model call, including instructions, the task, and selected history.
paragraphs.zh: 编程智能体框架（coding-agent harness），例如 Codex、Claude Code 和 Pi，让智能体能够通过反复的模型调用和工具使用来检查、修改并测试代码仓库（ Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026b ; Anthropic, 2026a ; earendil-works, 2026a ; Anomalyco, 2026 ; DeepSeek AI, 2026 ; Cursor Team, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026b ) 。 如图 4 所示，该框架反复执行工具调用、记录其结果，并准备下一次模型输入。 随着循环不断重复，该框架不断累积交互内容，并选择将哪些上下文包含在后续每次模型调用中。 通常，交互历史指的是这些交互的记录，而模型上下文指的是一次模型调用的输入，包括指令、任务以及所选的历史内容。

paragraphs.en: In long-horizon coding tasks, agents use this loop to carry out a sequence of interdependent development steps. Researchers have developed benchmarks to evaluate agents on such tasks. For example, SWE-Milestone requires agents to complete dependent milestones in a persistent repository ( Deng et al., 2026 ) ; ProgramBench requires whole-program reconstruction from documentation and an execute-only reference implementation ( Yang et al., 2026a ) ; and FrontierSWE covers open-ended implementation, performance optimization, and research tasks ( Chu et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 在长程编码任务中，智能体利用该循环执行一系列相互依赖的开发步骤。 研究人员已经开发了基准测试来评估智能体在这类任务上的表现。 例如，SWE-Milestone 要求智能体在一个持久化仓库中完成相互依赖的里程碑（Deng 等，2026）；ProgramBench 要求根据文档和仅可执行的参考实现重建完整程序（Yang 等，2026a）；FrontierSWE 则涵盖开放式实现、性能优化和研究类任务（Chu 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: To complete these tasks, an agent may perform subtasks within an ongoing subtask, each of which can span several iterations of this loop. When a subtask completes, the agent uses its result to resume the parent task, i.e., the task that directly contains it. Figure 1 (b) illustrates this recursive structure. Specifically, the compilation check returns its result to the parser update, which later returns its own result to the migration. When the same agent performs these nested subtasks, the harness records their interactions in one chronological history.
paragraphs.zh: 为完成这些任务，一个智能体可能会在正在进行的子任务中执行子任务，其中每个子任务都可能跨越此循环的多次迭代。 当一个子任务完成时，智能体会使用其结果来恢复父任务，即直接包含该子任务的任务。 图1（b）展示了这种递归结构。 具体而言，编译检查将其结果返回给解析器更新，而解析器更新随后将其自身的结果返回给迁移。 当同一个智能体执行这些嵌套的子任务时，测试框架会将它们的交互记录在同一条按时间顺序排列的历史记录中。

A harness can compact earlier interactions to keep later inputs within the context window, while the reduced input must retain the information needed to continue unfinished work ( OpenAI, 2025 ; Young, 2025 ) . With exact-prefix caching, rewriting an earlier token prevents reuse of cached computation beyond that point, while the unchanged prefix remains reusable ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Lumer et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 仅凭这一次指令（order）并不能标明检查从何处开始、在何处结束，也无法标明其未完成的父任务还需要哪些交互。 测试框架可以对较早的交互进行压缩，使后续输入保持在上下文窗口之内，而被压缩后的输入必须保留继续未完成工作所需的信息（OpenAI, 2025；Young, 2025）。 在精确前缀缓存下，重写较早的某个词元（token）会使其后已缓存计算无法复用，而未改变的前缀仍可复用（Zheng et al., 2024；Lumer et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Recent approaches manage model context by selecting, condensing, or retaining information across calls. For example, AgentDiet uses a separate reflection model to remove redundant or expired material within a sliding window of history ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) , while AgentFold lets the agent summarize selected historical spans at different granular levels ( Ye et al., 2026 ) . Other approaches provide context condensation as a callable operation ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . For coding agents, SWE-Pruner selects task-relevant lines from incoming file observations ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , whereas AttnCompress uses proxy attention to select blocks from accumulated trajectories ( Zeng et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: Recursive calls give each child its own context and let it invoke further children before returning a result to its parent ( Yang et al., 2026b ; Schroeder et al., 2025 ; Lumer et al., 2026b ) . Recursive Agent Harnesses applies this pattern to a complete tool-using harness, such that each child has its own context, workspace, and tools ( Lumer et al., 2026b ) . THREAD recursively spawns child execution threads with contexts derived from their parents and returns selected outputs to the parent threads ( Schroeder et al., 2025 ) . Current advanced coding-agent harnesses also expose this delegation pattern; for example, Codex can spawn child sessions from a parent thread and return their results, while Claude Code can invoke subagents through programmatic workflows ( OpenAI, 2026c ; Anthropic, 2026a ) .

paragraphs.en: However, when subtask boundaries are established through child-agent calls, finer-grained task decomposition also requires more agent executions and communication. AgentPrune finds that some messages contribute little to task completion in the evaluated multi-agent systems, yet are still encapsulated as the receiving agents’ model inputs and consume tokens ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) . paragraphs.zh: 然而，当子任务边界通过子智能体调用建立时，更细粒度的任务分解也需要更多的智能体执行和通信。 AgentPrune 发现在所评估的多智能体系统中，某些消息对任务完成的贡献很小，但仍被封装为接收方智能体的模型输入并消耗 token（Zhang et al., 2025）。 KVCOMM 表明，当共享内容的前缀不同时，普通的前缀缓存无法直接复用其计算，导致智能体不得不重复处理相同的内容（Ye et al., 2025）。 因此，递归的子任务边界应当独立于工作是留在当前智能体还是委派给另一智能体来表示。

paragraphs.en: Spine is an interface that aligns model context with subtask nesting and completion in a just-in-time manner. Specifically, it addresses the three issues illustrated in Section 1 as follows: (1) the agent declares explicit subtask boundaries and completion status through work scopes and a persistent SpineTree (Section 4.1 ); (2) the interface decouples subtask granularity from executing agent choice by supporting both local inline nesting and parallel delegation (Section 4.2 ); and (3) the runtime dynamically distinguishes completed subtasks from unfinished subtasks by compiling context just in time, resuming parent tasks with submitted results while preserving prefix caches (Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: Spine 是一个接口，以即时方式将模型上下文与子任务的嵌套和完成状态对齐。 具体而言，它按如下方式解决第 1 节中说明的三个问题：（1）智能体通过工作范围和持久化的 SpineTree 声明显式的子任务边界和完成状态（第 4.1 节）；（2）该接口通过同时支持局部内联嵌套和并行委派，将子任务粒度与执行智能体的选择解耦（第 4.2 节）；（3）运行时通过即时编译上下文，动态区分已完成子任务与未完成子任务，在保留前缀缓存的同时恢复带有已提交结果的父任务（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: The fundamental unit of interaction with Spine is a work scope, i.e., an agent-declared subtask with an explicit entry, a parent task, and a result submitted on completion. Within a scope, the current agent can inspect files, edit code, and run checks over multiple turns. Entering a nested subtask forms a child scope whose result returns to the unfinished parent. We call work performed by the current agent inline work , whereas delegated work is performed by another agent.
paragraphs.zh: 与 Spine 交互的基本单位是工作范围（work scope），即由智能体声明的子任务，它具有明确的入口、一个父任务，以及完成后提交的结果。 在一个范围内，当前智能体可以在多个回合中检查文件、编辑代码并运行检查。 进入嵌套子任务会形成一个子范围，其结果会返回到尚未完成的父任务。 我们将当前智能体执行的工作称为内联工作（inline work），而委托工作（delegated work）则由另一个智能体执行。

paragraphs.en: The interface provides four commands for organizing work during task execution, decoupling subtask nesting from executor choice. The agent uses Open to enter a child scope locally and Close to complete it with a result, allowing the same agent to execute nested subtasks inline without multi-agent overhead. Once the child completes, the parent resumes with that result in its model context. Next combines completion with entry into a sibling scope, while Spawn delegates independent subtasks to other agents in parallel and collects their results. Ordinary model and tool interactions continue within the current scope between these commands.
paragraphs.zh: 该接口提供四个命令，用于在任务执行过程中组织工作，将子任务嵌套与执行者选择解耦。 智能体使用 Open 在本地进入子作用域，使用 Close 完成子作用域并返回结果，使同一智能体能够内联执行嵌套子任务，而无需多智能体的开销。 子作用域完成后，父作用域带着该结果恢复执行，结果保留在其模型上下文中。 Next 将完成与进入兄弟作用域结合在一起，而 Spawn 将独立的子任务并行委派给其他智能体并收集它们的结果。 在这些命令之间，普通的模型和工具交互仍在当前作用域内继续进行。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate Spine on three widely-adopted benchmarks covering continuous repository evolution, whole-program reconstruction, and open-ended engineering. Table 2 summarizes the tasks evaluated and the metrics used for each benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个广泛采用的基准上评估 Spine，这些基准涵盖持续仓库演化、全程序重建和开放式工程。 表 2 总结了所评估的任务以及每个基准所使用的指标。

sents.en: We evaluate Spine on three widely-adopted benchmarks covering continuous repository evolution, whole-program reconstruction, and open-ended engineering.
sents.zh: 我们在三个广泛采用的基准上评估 Spine，这些基准涵盖持续仓库演化、全程序重建和开放式工程。

paragraphs.en: SWE-Milestone ( Deng et al., 2026 ) requires agents to complete dependent milestones in a persistent repository (e.g., upgrading go-zero’s go-redis dependency from v8 to v9 ( SWE-Milestone Team, 2026 ) ) while preserving existing behaviors.
paragraphs.zh: SWE-Milestone（Deng et al., 2026）要求智能体在一个持久化仓库中完成具有依赖关系的里程碑任务（例如，将 go-zero 的 go-redis 依赖从 v8 升级到 v9（SWE-Milestone Team, 2026）），同时保持既有行为不变。

paragraphs.en: ProgramBench ( Yang et al., 2026a ) requires agents to reconstruct programs ranging from command-line utilities to FFmpeg and SQLite ( ProgramBench, 2026a ; ProgramBench, 2026b ) using documentation and an execute-only reference implementation. Agents produce source code and build files, which are evaluated through hidden tests that check whether the resulting program reproduces the reference behavior.
paragraphs.zh: ProgramBench（Yang et al., 2026a）要求智能体使用文档和仅可执行的参考实现来重建从命令行工具到 FFmpeg 和 SQLite（ProgramBench, 2026a; ProgramBench, 2026b）等各类程序。 智能体生成源代码和构建文件，通过隐藏测试来评估这些文件，检查所生成的程序是否能复现参考实现的行为。

Continuous scores measure partial progress toward each task’s objective.

paragraphs.en: Across all three benchmarks, we report their official evaluation metrics. For SWE-Milestone, we report its official metric Score (%) ( Deng et al., 2026 ) , which evaluates milestone progress as the harmonic mean of test recall (new functionality) and precision (regression prevention), and the number of milestones passing all required tests ( # Resolved ). For ProgramBench ( Yang et al., 2026a ) , we report the numbers of tasks passing all tests ( # Resolved ) or at least 95% of tests ( # Almost , including fully resolved tasks), together with the average test-pass rate across tasks ( Avg. pass (%) ). For FrontierSWE ( Chu et al., 2026 ) , we report the mean ( Mean@5 ) and maximum ( Best@5 ) scores over five trials per task.
paragraphs.zh: 在全部三个基准上，我们报告其官方评估指标。 对于 SWE-Milestone，我们报告其官方指标 Score (%) ( Deng et al., 2026 )，该指标以测试召回率（新功能）和精确率（回归防范）的调和平均数来评估里程碑进展，同时报告通过全部所需测试的里程碑数量 ( # Resolved )。 对于 ProgramBench ( Yang et al., 2026a )，我们报告通过全部测试 ( # Resolved ) 或至少 95% 测试 ( # Almost，包含完全解决的任务) 的任务数量，以及各任务的平均测试通过率 ( Avg. pass (%) )。 对于 FrontierSWE ( Chu et al., 2026 )，我们报告每个任务五次试验的平均分 ( Mean@5 ) 和最高分 ( Best@5 )。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate Spine across different types of agent harnesses, we select two popular open-source systems: Codex ( OpenAI, 2026b ) , which features a native session lifecycle, and Pi ( earendil-works, 2026a ) , which provides an extensible plugin architecture. We implement Spine on them as SpineCodex and SpinePi , respectively, both of which are ready to use out of the box with their original harnesses, Codex and Pi , as baseline controls.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在不同类型的智能体框架上评估 Spine，我们选取了两个流行的开源系统：Codex（OpenAI, 2026b），其特点是具有原生会话生命周期；以及 Pi（earendil-works, 2026a），其提供了可扩展的插件架构。 我们在这两个系统上实现了 Spine，分别称为 SpineCodex 和 SpinePi，二者均可与其原始框架 Codex 和 Pi 开箱即用，作为基线对照。

paragraphs.en: Codex / SpineCodex . SpineCodex connects to Codex’s native session lifecycle to support work scopes, forked child sessions, and execution resumption, with approximately 17K lines of Rust code.

paragraphs.en: For SWE-Milestone, we follow the official protocol and resume each run until all milestones have been submitted for evaluation ( DeepCommit-ai, 2026b ) . Given the cost of evaluating all 200 tasks, we randomly sample 50 tasks from ProgramBench and retain its six-hour and 1,000-step limits ( Yang et al., 2026a ) . For FrontierSWE, we evaluate a fixed subset of ten available V1 tasks with five trials per task and a 20-hour budget per trial. Seven of its 17 tasks ( Chu et al., 2026 ) are unavailable in our environment, including optimizer-design , which requires an H100 GPU ( Proximal, 2026d ) , and frogsgame-rl , which requires the external Tinker API and network access ( Proximal, 2026b ) . We evaluate FrontierSWE in RQ1 to cover open-ended engineering tasks, while RQ2 evaluates harness generalizability on SWE-Milestone and ProgramBench. paragraphs.en: Table 5 presents the performance and cost comparison across context-management approaches on SWE-Milestone. In AgentDiet , reducing source-inspection history from 11.7k to 1.6k tokens while implementation is pending leads to repeated source rereading (Figure 7 a), resolving fewer milestones than Codex (12 vs. 14) at higher cost ($1,098.52 vs. $681.22). Similarly, our Context Folding baseline uses a single-level plan–branch–return workflow and resolves 13 milestones (vs. 14 for Codex ), using 19.5% more tokens at 29.4% higher cost than SpineCodex . While Recursive Subagent achieves a Score comparable to SpineCodex (42.4% vs. 42.6%, resolving 17 vs. 19 milestones), establishing every subtask boundary through delegation causes child agents to account for 75.5% of its 32,650 model requests (vs. 8,792 for SpineCodex ; Figure 7 b), driving cost to $1,749.73 (vs. $460.77). In contrast, SpineCodex executes nested subtasks locally while maintaining explicit work boundaries, resolving the most milestones (19) at the lowest cost ($460.77).

paragraphs.en: Ablation study. To evaluate the core mechanisms in Spine —subtask nesting and explicit work-boundary representation—we evaluate two ablations across three representative SWE-Milestone projects (Navidrome ( DeepCommit-ai, 2026c ) , ripgrep ( DeepCommit-ai, 2026d ) , and Element ( DeepCommit-ai, 2026a ) ) under our default model (GPT-5.6 Sol at high effort, three runs per configuration; Table 7 ). Depth 1 limits scopes to one level below the root, testing whether multi-level nesting is needed beyond single-level plan–branch–return workflows. No boundary maintenance removes explicit boundary markers and node states from model inputs while retaining runtime state compilation, isolating the effect of presenting boundary cues to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 消融实验。 为了评估 Spine 中的核心机制——子任务嵌套与显式工作边界表示——我们在默认模型（GPT-5.6 Sol，高算力，每种配置运行三次；表 7）下，在三个具有代表性的 SWE-Milestone 项目（Navidrome ( DeepCommit-ai, 2026c )、ripgrep ( DeepCommit-ai, 2026d ) 和 Element ( DeepCommit-ai, 2026a )）上评估了两种消融设置。 Depth 1 将作用域限制在根节点之下一层，以检验在单层「计划—分支—返回」工作流之外是否还需要多级嵌套。 No boundary maintenance 则在保留运行时状态编译的同时，从模型输入中移除显式的边界标记与节点状态，从而隔离向智能体呈现边界线索所带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: Across all three projects, SpineCodex improves Score by 7.7–27.3% over both ablations, resolving more milestones at lower cost with shorter inputs (Table 7 ). Restricting nesting (Depth 1) raises average input per request from 59.8K–78.1K to 82.8K–99.5K, showing that shallow scopes fail to isolate intermediate interactions within nested subtasks. paragraphs.en: Threats to internal validity. Differences in experimental settings and implementation choices may affect comparisons between methods. To mitigate these effects, we evaluate all approaches under the same model, harness, task set, and execution budget within each comparison, and conduct all runs in isolated containers. paragraphs.en: We presented Spine , an interface that enables agents to explicitly declare subtask boundaries, allowing model context to align with subtask nesting and completion. It separates subtask boundaries from delegation and uses SpineTree to construct context that retains unfinished subtasks’ interactions and replaces completed subtasks’ details with their results. We integrated Spine into Codex and evaluated it on SWE-Milestone, ProgramBench, and FrontierSWE. With GPT-5.6 Sol, SpineCodex improves SWE-Milestone Score by 11.8% while reducing total cost by 32.4%, compared with native Codex. A plugin integration into Pi also improves SWE-Milestone Score and the average ProgramBench test-pass rate compared with native Pi under both evaluated models, including an open-weight model. By decoupling subtask boundaries from delegation and compiling context around hierarchical work structures just in time, Spine demonstrates that coding agents can sustain complex, long-horizon engineering tasks effectively and economically.
